mechanical_reference.purpose: 真实热史与切削制造需求分析的本构参考；不由这些参考赋予CI-A1或PMZ断裂容量
mechanical_reference.phase_state_policy: 按实际热史计算出生域与固相域交集；存留固体保留应力、塑性与参照，新生凝固域保留当时偏应变构型，体积参照由同一质量、冷态密度和参考体积确定
mechanical_reference.cut_space_displacement_policy: 保留已接受P1材料几何；新的固相域仿射延拓仅约束Newton位移增量，不投影既有总位移或追加表示补偿体积参照；真实新界面闭合保留其应变需求

new_coherent_specific_volume.basis: CAD沉积包络由冷态质量与密度生成；不能再次将该冷态体积指定为高温无应力体积而重复计入冷却收缩
new_coherent_specific_volume.thermal_bulk_strain: 采用原有平均热膨胀系数，由平衡方程形成热态体积
new_coherent_specific_volume.coordinate_update: 质量随存留材料传递，更新参考坐标后重新计算质量比，不将既存固体参照或塑性清零

QT_reference.source_location: Farahani等2024 Fig4，GJS500-14球铁；下列为图读近似值
QT_reference.yield_grade_scale_basis: QT450-10工程名义Rp310/来源图读室温Rp380；仅迁移归一化温度形状
QT_reference.strain_policy: 平均膨胀系数乘(T-20)，不二次积分平均系数
QT_reference.applicability: 温度形状来自不同Si含量/牌号球铁，不能当作本批QT或Ni富集重熔区的测量；重熔区域单独标识并作参考材料敏感性

high_Ni_reference.high_temperature_extension: 900℃以上E按最后已知斜率延拓至相变区；600℃以上屈服按40MPa线性降至液相线0；这是明确的工程参考延拓，不是原厂数据
high_Ni_reference.strain_policy: 采用20℃为参照的平均系数乘(T-20)；900℃以上平均系数取至1000℃已知16.7e-6，再按末段斜率延拓
high_Ni_reference.applicability: Ni201低碳退火态与CI-A1含C约1%熔敷态不同；当前首先计算低屈服参考的制造需求，不宣称它严格包络CI-A1或混合区

hardening.model: QT参考理想弹塑性；Ni201参考采用原厂两个规定塑性偏移点的线性硬化弦
hardening.Ni201_basis: Table4b在20～600℃的Rp1.0-Rp0.2均为25MPa，H=25/(0.010-0.002)；零塑性屈服=Rp0.2-0.002H，使两个偏移点均被复现
hardening.high_temperature_scope: 600℃以上随屈服同一系数线性降至本工况液相线0，这是参考延拓，不是原厂高温数据
hardening.reason: QT未取得可用硬化曲线，不增加硬化容量；材料参考需求保留实际塑性增量，不替代CI-A1或PMZ脆性断裂评价

furnace_continuation.scope: 200℃保温2h引用已登记同类工艺；50℃/h为事前冻结的控温炉设计设置，完整温度场经边界换热连续求解

source_state_policy: actual nodal thermal/deposition history; actual previous/current solid-domain intersection retains reference/plasticity; newly coherent shear follows current configuration and specific volume follows carried mass/rho20/reference-volume
liquid_policy: exact_P1 material phase volume: existing solid-state tensors retained by solid volume; liquid carries no shear
remelted_QT_constitutive_scope: cast-family reference in this demand case; region recorded separately, no pristine QT/PMZ fracture capacity assigned
bond_policy: separate newly connected material freedoms before recorded whole-face temperature exceeds both actual liquidus values; strong solid bond activates only when the complete P1 facet is below both solidus temperatures; surviving reference/plasticity retained through real closure
interface_facet_time_policy: strong full-facet coherent branch; its activation timing requires the retained-state mesh/time response check
parent_extension_strain_scope: equilibrium-history maximum_total_strain_norm includes unborn/liquid parent extensions; use full-solid metrics for actual solid geometry
component_policy: affine interpolation independent for every connected solid body; six rigid-increment coordinate gauges retain its inherited pose through separation/reconnection; no cross-body support
stress_measure: Cauchy stress from work-conjugate Hencky stress through the exact log-strain derivative; physical force uses first Piola stress
finite_kinematics_source: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cma.2023.116101; finite log-strain additive plasticity; existing reference-material demand curves
new_coherent_material_policy: current shear configuration plus mass/density cold specific-volume reference; thermal bulk strain solved by equilibrium, no surviving material history reset
cut_space_displacement_policy: accepted P1 geometry retained; current cut-space constrains Newton increments only; no representation-only reference shift
coherent_reference_initialization_order: actual preclosure configuration; interface joining displacement is never initialized as stress-free new-material shear
